findings.reason: the plan should either extract the shared helper (the repo already does this in `tests/distribution_sources.py`) or replace its scope argument with one that actually explains why two copies of the same three-variable pin must be maintained.
findings.text: §5 has the conftest cap repeat the `os.environ.setdefault("OMP_NUM_THREADS"/"OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS"/"MKL_NUM_THREADS", …)` pin already owned by `oracle_probe.py:54-56`; the plan declines to share it on the grounds that "consolidating the runtime pins is a refactor of runtime code outside this plan", but extracting a `pin_blas_threads(n)` helper does not require touching any runtime caller — only the two set-sites call it — so the stated reason does not block the extraction it rules out, and the two literal copies can drift

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the change is one session-level hook in the conftest every test already passes through (`tests/conftest.py`); it adds no module family and hides the per-worker arithmetic behind that single hook.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the conftest cap re-implements the env-var thread-pool pin whose only current owner is `imas_ambix/statespace/oracle_probe.py:54-56`, and the repo already extracts shared test helpers rather than forking them (`tests/distribution_sources.py`).
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §5 adds a dev-group dependency and a conftest hook, none of which is in those four families, so there is nothing for it to retire or merge.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan names the one existing thread-pool pin in the repo (`imas_ambix/statespace/oracle_probe.py:54-56`) and the census guard that decides declarations (`tests/test_declared_dependencies.py`), and states it will not extract the pin rather than silently rebuilding it.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the conftest cap is a layer over the existing BLAS/OpenMP pin, and the plan states in its own text why it does not extend that machinery to a shared helper (scope difference between runtime processes and test workers), which is the justification this item requires; the strength of that justification is contested under duplicate_owner.
